source_text: The Zorvo community event is on 12 May 2027, with a second session on 14 June 2027. Entry is 47 rupees per person and a group of 10 pays 425 rupees. Call 9876543210 to reserve. The talk starts at 6 pm and lasts 45 minutes. Kal apne friends ko message bhej dena. We want everyone to feel welcome, so let's break the ice with a quick game.
